subject: Nimbus Health — decision ecosystem & internal sponsor plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus Health — decision ecosystem & internal sponsor plan

Hi Lydia — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick written recap from our discovery so you have a single place for the asks and next steps. Happy to update if I missed anything.

Call highlights
- Primary outcome: Validate POC success criteria (latency < 300ms 95th, de-identified PHI handling, 3-week pilot).
- Economic owner: CFO (you mentioned Sarah will sign off for pilots > $50k).
- Security gate: InfoSec wants SOC 2 type II evidence + mapping for data retention and encryption in transit + at-rest.
- Procurement: standard MSFT SOW + 45-day PO cadence; procurement contact: procurement@nimbushealth.com.
- Technical approver: Tom Baker (CTO) will sign off on network/SSO and the sandbox test.

Proposed next steps
1) I attached a short discovery recap (NRI-Discovery-Recap.pdf). Please share with Sarah and Tom.
2) We’ll provision a 3-week sandbox POC. I need a SCIM/SSO contact and an IP allowlist window (suggested window: Jun 14–Jul 2).
3) Security asks: I’ll send over our SOC 2 summary and the data flow diagram. If InfoSec wants the full report we can provide it under an NDA — please confirm the contact and NDA owner.
4) Procurement: Ben can join the PO/contract call. Lauren will coordinate onboarding and success metrics.

Immediate asks for your team
- Can Sarah (CFO) review the enclosed ROI summary before our call next week? If yes, can you include her email so I can follow up?
- Can Tom share the best technical contact for SSO/IP work?

Meeting availability: we proposed Fri Jun 4 10am PT for the internal alignment with your CIO — does that still work?

Thanks — I’ll wait for the contact names and we’ll get the right artifacts over.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: NRI-Discovery-Recap.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — decision ecosystem & internal sponsor plan

Karthik — thanks for the crisp recap, this matches our notes. Quick answers and a few asks: 

- I’ll loop Sarah (CFO) — she’s out until Mon but I’ll introduce her to your ROI doc. Her email: sarah.taylor@nimbushealth.com.
- Tom will share our SSO engineer, cc’ing him now: tom.baker@nimbushealth.com (he asked that we include the network team alias: netops@nimbushealth.com).
- Procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com will own the PO timeline — they asked for a high-level commercial (ballpark) for the sandbox to include in the MOP. Can you provide a short table of sandbox cost + estimated production annual run-rate?
- Security: InfoSec asked whether you can share a redacted SOC 2 (we can sign an NDA if needed). They also want sample retention policy language for patient de-identified data.

Yes to Fri Jun 4 10am PT for the alignment call with Sarah and Tom — please send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Lydia Park
Head of Product, Nimbus Health
lydia.park@nimbushealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — Nimbus next steps & sponsor enablement (internal)

Team — quick internal note (do not forward to Nimbus as-is).

Summary of asks from Nimbus: CFO intro (Sarah), SSO/contact from Tom, procurement wants a sandbox commercial & PO timeline, InfoSec wants redacted SOC2 + retention language. They confirmed Fri Jun 4 10am PT for an internal alignment call that includes Sarah and Tom.

Enablement/talk tracks for Sarah (economic owner):
- Focus on predictable unit economics: show the 3-week sandbox as a risk-limited evaluation with capped spend (we propose $7.5k for the sandbox) and modeled 12-month run-rate for 6M tokens/month at $0.0012/token = $86k/year (example figures; adjust for actual usage).
- Value framing: reduce clinician time spent triaging notes by 30% (internal case study), faster patient throughput, and lower FTE load on records team.
- Procurement ask: emphasize that sandbox is rev-neutral if pilot meets criteria; propose 30-day invoice terms for pilot.

Security/technical enablement (Lauren):
- Attach the SOC2 summary and a template retention clause.
- Prep a 1-page network/SSO runbook for Tom and netops (scoping: SAML + IP allowlisting window).

Commercial (Ben):
- Provide a short commercial table: sandbox flat fee, estimated dev/test credits, production annual run-rate bands. I can mock numbers below and clean them for external:
  - Sandbox (3 weeks): $7,500 flat
  - PoC dev credits: up to $2,000 included
  - Est. annual run-rate (6M tokens/mo): $86,000/year (example)

Attachments for meeting: I attached a one-pager ROI table (NRI-ROI-1pager.xlsx). Please review and give feedback by EOD so I can share with Sarah on Mon.

—
Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — decision ecosystem & internal sponsor plan

Karthik / Lauren — I’ll join the Fri alignment with Sarah and Tom. I updated the commercial stub in HubSpot and added a draft mutual action plan: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890 (HubSpot record).

High-level talk track for procurement: treat the sandbox as a scoped eval (single invoice) and remove friction with a simple SOW + scope appendix. If procurement asks about indemnity/DP terms we can route to legal but aim to keep the pilot agreement compact.

I also dropped the DocuSign link for the NDA we use for SOC 2 exchange: https://www.docusign.com/collector?envelopeId=abc-123-nim

One quick ask: Karthik — can you confirm the exact sandbox start window (earliest we can ship infra) so I can propose a PO target date?

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com, sarah.taylor@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — decision ecosystem & internal sponsor plan

Thanks all — calendar invite accepted. Sarah is on the invite and procurement looped in. A couple of quick items for the meeting:

- Please bring the redacted SOC 2 summary and the retention policy language for de-identified patient data (one slide).
- Confirm sandbox start window and the proposed $7.5k sandbox fee in the deck. Procurement wants the PO lead time and invoice cadence.
- Tom requested a 10-min technical run-through on the sandbox networking/SSO plan.

If you can drop the two artifacts in the invite or the meeting thread before EOD Thu (we're in different timezones but want to review ahead), that'd be great.

See you Fri.

Best,
Lydia
